title: Free in Laredo: 20 Community Events That Cost You Nothing, Oct 19–31
excerpt: Everything on this list is free. No tickets, no cover, no catch — just show up.
content:
Everything on this list is free. No tickets, no cover, no catch — just show up.

Vote and Be Heard (Free, Obviously)

Early voting runs Oct 19–30 at 14 county sites (main site: 720 Convent Ave). The Downtown Business Improvement District board meets Tuesday Oct 20 at 5 PM at City Hall, and Webb County Commissioners Court holds its regular session Tuesday Oct 27 at 9 AM — both open to the public.

Free Job Fairs and School Events

JobFairX runs two free online fairs: healthcare (Tue Oct 20) and diversity (Wed Oct 28), both with AI-matched interviews. TAMIU at LC Day brings university reps to Laredo College Wednesday Oct 21, 10 AM–1 PM. TAMIU's National Transfer Week events run Oct 19–23, the Make a Difference Day volunteer cleanup is Saturday Oct 24 (9 AM–12 PM, four Zacate Creek sites).

Free Halloween Fun

Friday Oct 23: The Dance Spot Trunk or Treat (5:30–7:30 PM, free trick-or-treating), the Planet Dental Halloween Event on Zapata Hwy (5–7 PM, 2522 South Zapata Hwy), and the City of Laredo Halloween Health Fair — free screenings including mammograms, plus haircuts, basketball clinics, and raffles (location to be announced).

Saturday Oct 24: the Trunk or Treat Boo Bash at Rodeo Dental & Orthodontics (12–2 PM, 910 Guadalupe St) and the La Casa de Cristo Trunk or Treat (6–8 PM, no registration needed).

Sunday Oct 25: the Binational Anti-Bullying Poetry Contest (2 PM, LISD Performing Arts Center) — poems in any language, costumes encouraged, $200 prizes per winner.

Tuesday Oct 27: free live music by Six Strings at La Tapiz Restaurant in the DoubleTree (7–9 PM).

Thursday Oct 29: the Fall Harvest Festival at Doctors Hospital ER Wright Ranch (from 5 PM, 2801 Cuatro Vientos Rd) and Halloweenfest on the Laredo College campus (food booths, inflatables, music, free pumpkin patch).

Friday Oct 30: Family Trunk or Treat (6–8 PM, 1518 East Hillside Rd), the Planet Dental Calton Halloween Event (from 5 PM, 301 W Calton), the 2nd Annual SOAR Special Needs Trunk or Treat (6–8:30 PM at Evangel Church — sensory-friendly), and the Big Texas Little Film Tour at Casa Ortiz (7:30 PM, 915 Zaragoza St).

Saturday Oct 31: the Trunk or Treat Boo Bash (12–2 PM, 1918 US-83).

Know a free event we missed? Tell us — we'll add it.
